source_rationale.fork_handshake: Pinned Rust Linux process source receives an eight-byte status through Socket::read, implemented by libc::recv with flags zero. source_rationale.correction: Allow only unnamed socketpair(AF_UNIX, SOCK_SEQPACKET with optional CLOEXEC, protocol0) and recvfrom(count8, flags0, addressNULL, address-lengthNULL). Both words of size_t and pointer arguments are checked; all other recvfrom calls remain denied. Socket/connect/bind/listen/sendto/sendmsg/recvmsg/io_uring, x32, execveat and memfd remain denied. No null-write or broad executable/library grant.
source_rationale.inherited_descriptor_limit: As with already-permitted read/write, seccomp cannot revoke an inherited network socket or bind this receive to a prior socketpair. Existing clean Supervisor input-descriptor boundary remains required.

After the expected compiler-execution omission counter, remove only that probe-owned child and require the identical empty 0700 parent before the positive. Prelaunch failures retain actual outer adapter diagnostics.
